HON 2Q26: Solid results coming in better than expected with a guidance raise

This seemed to be a solid quarter for Honeywell Technologies overall. Top line organic growth was up 4% vs. expectations to be flat, and adjusted operating margin was largely in line with expectations at 19%. EPS of \$1.95 is \~7% ahead of consensus.

Organic growth for all three segments came in better than expected (BA 9% vs. 6.5% consensus, PAT at -1% vs. -7.5% consensus, IA at 4% vs. 0.5% consensus). Segment operating margins also came in better than expected (\~20 - 30 bps depending on the business unit). Guidance was marginally raised as well for the full year; organic growth is up to 3 - 4% (vs. 2 - 3% earlier), segment margins are up to 20.3% at the midpoint (vs. \~20.0% earlier), and the EPS guidance midpoint is \$8.20 vs. \$8.10 in earlier.
EXPECTED CHANGE TO CONSENSUS EARNINGS
No Change

Numbers :Revenue of \$5,187 million beat consensus of approximately \$4,978 million by 4.2%, representing 3.4% YoY growth versus \$5,018 million in 2Q'25. Organic growth of 4.0% beat the consensus expectation of 0.2% by 380 bps. EBIT (segment profit) of \$985 million beat consensus of \$943 million by 4.4%. Operating margin of 19.0% beat the consensus estimate of 18.9% by 5 bps. Adjusted EPS of \$1.95 beat the Street estimate of \$1.82 by 7.4%.

Segments: Industrial Automation: Revenue of \$1,501 million beat consensus of \$1,457 million by 3.0%, compared with \$1,577 million in 2Q'25. Organic growth of 4.0% compares with 0.0% in 2Q'25 and beat the consensus expectation of 0.5% by 350 bps. Segment operating income of \$258 million beat consensus of \$247 million by 4.5%, while segment operating margin of 17.2% compared with 16.3% in 2Q'25 and 16.9% consensus, exceeding expectations by 25 bps.

Building Automation: Revenue of \$2,002 million beat consensus of \$1,954 million by 2.5%, compared with \$1,826 million in 2Q'25. Organic growth of 9.0% compares with 8.0% in 2Q'25 and beat the consensus expectation of 6.5% by 250 bps. Segment operating income of \$542 million beat consensus of \$524 million by 3.5%, while segment operating margin of 27.1% compared with 26.2% in 2Q'25 and 26.8% consensus, exceeding expectations by 29 bps.

Process Automation: Revenue of \$1,679 million beat consensus of \$1,549 million by 8.4%, compared with \$1,613 million in 2Q'25. Organic growth of -1.0% compares with 6.0% in 2Q'25 and beat the consensus expectation of -7.5% by 650 bps. Segment operating income of \$371 million beat consensus of \$342 million by 8.4%, while segment operating margin of 22.1% compared with 23.9% in 2Q'25 and

VALUATION METHODOLOGY
Honeywell International Inc

We value Honeywell (including the Aerospace business) at 20x NTM + 1 EPS (estimated at \$10.19) giving us a target price for the full business of \$204. We add another \$39 based on the value of their stake in QNT (assuming a \$94 target price). This implies an overall \$243 target price.
RISKS
Honeywell International Inc
Upside: (i) Continued growth in Building Automation, Positive uptake of Forge product reflecting in more recurring revenue, Margin expansion in IA business post WWS / PPS spin

Downside: (i) Power prices stay stable or decline as supply comes online (reducing impetus for building automation), (ii) Weakness / delays in LNG projects which market is not pricing, (iii) Organizational drag from spin-off of aerospace
